comment: Enemy archetypes. Hydra stats are scaled from Heroes Idle STORY_CSV 'Hydra Grunt' (ATK 5, HP 200) into this stage's hero numbers (hero ATK 300-400 per hit, HP 500-620): HP x7 -> 1400 (about 4-5 Robot shots / 4-5 melee hits), bolt damage x6 -> 30 (a hero survives ~17-20 bolts; i-frames after a hit mean a 3-round burst lands at most once). Tuned down from x8 / 40 dmg and 2.3 s cooldown after autopilot playtests: solo heroes ran out of HP around the 2nd pit. Elite = palette swap, 2x HP, 1.5x damage, faster bolts and a shorter (1.8 s) cooldown. Values are world px / ms / per-hit HP.

hydra.name: Hydra Grunt
hydra.source: Heroes Idle STORY_CSV: Hydra Grunt ATK 5 / HP 200

elite.name: Hydra Elite
elite.source: palette swap of the Grunt (black/crimson suit, red lenses)

planned.commander: Hydra Commander - later boss: Elite rig at ~0.6 scale-up, own palette (white/gold), 3 phases (burst fire, grenade arc, summons 2 Grunts), ~12000 HP. Not in this build.
